name: b25_driver_fp_r8
description: Full-precision rank-8 LoRA on Ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B PTQ1_0 for the Data Goblin driver (DataGoblin hill-climb lane self_adapter). Train: 2000 curated exact-oracle rows from the hill-climb decision bench, train split seed 1 (gate_verdict 814, proposal_legality 721, next_lane 465; bench make -> export-sft -> curate, admitted.jsonl). Val: 89 curated rows from train split seed 2, with the 7 rows whose bench view also occurs in seed 1 removed. The dev bench (split dev, seed 0) is never trained on. One epoch: 250 steps x 8 rows.
